description: CUSTOMER SETUP — create a durable server-side setup session from an acquisition choice: client_type (team size/use) plus setup_scope (race|county|district|state|multi), optional geography (state/county_fips/party), and…

contest_id.description: Exact canonical contest identity. Alternatively pass office/state/district/cycle/stage.

custom_office_label.description: Explicit custom office label; required before the operational campaign can be completed.

cycle.description: Required explicitly for custom campaigns, including odd years. Listed models support 2024, 2026, 2028 and 2030.

district.description: District GEOID or validated alias for districted offices (e.g. 3403, NJ-03, or AL for an at-large state).

office.description: The race office: president | senate | house | governor | state_senate | state_assembly.

setup_scope.description: The deliberately chosen initial map scope. Required by current onboarding; optional for legacy callers.

workspace_scope.description: Optional workspace for THIS call: use an exact personal/team ID from list_workspaces. Repeat on each call; it does not change the connection default. Must agree with MCP metadata and the effective HTTP workspace selector (header, otherwise connector URL). OAuth connections can only use their granted workspace. Membership and campaign permissions still apply.

name: start_setup
